transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining this implementation huddle. As we all know, Riverside Urgent Care Clinic has requested an emergency blood-product reserve to support patients before they can be transferred to the main hospital. Currently, Riverside has no blood products assigned to its inventory, so this would be a new initiative. Before I can finalize any decision on whether this reserve goes live and what operating requirements accompany it, I need to review the plan thoroughly with all of you — transfusion medicine, laboratory operations, courier services, and nursing education. I'd like to start by hearing from each of you regarding what you see as the key considerations, protocols, or concerns we need to address. Please also make sure that any source documents or protocols you reference are formally disclosed through the meeting record, as our huddle documentation policy requires. Let's begin.
